comment: Source of truth for the shipped fonts (docs/typography.md). tools/build-assets.mjs copies dist/ into public/assets/fonts/ and records the sizes and hashes in manifest.json and PROVENANCE.csv. design/fonts/build-fonts.py rebuilds dist/ from src/ (a dev-time step: it needs Python fontTools and brotli, nothing runs at game time).

fonts.role: Display face: logo text, headlines, buttons, banners, countdown, rank, HUD numerals, popups
UI face: body text, small text, hints, labels, toasts

source.name: Fredoka
source.author: Milena B. Brandao, Ben Nathan (Fredoka Project Authors)
